description:
Recently there has been a lot of hub-bub within the SDA universe due to some statements made by and about an SDA pastor named Conrad Vine. This kerfuffle has sparked a trifecta of SDA doctrines to bubble back up to the surface—the Remnant, the Shaking, and Babylon. SDA pastor Mark Finley, from @HL365, made a video addressing some of this which provided a perfect opportunity to examine these claims more closely in light of the current SDA infighting.

Laodicea = Adventism? https://youtube.com/live/nu-oZ2vekB8
